svg.title: Kubernetes Service Types
svg.desc: Structural diagram showing the four Kubernetes service types: ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, and ExternalName, with traffic flow and access scope.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain ClusterIP in Kubernetes in more detail')

Provisions an external IP via cloud

g.text: Maps service to external DNS name
